page.layout: One page of text in a single main column; margin notes at left (in the outer-left margin, beside the upper and middle part of the text); a running head at top centre with "Cap.9." at upper left in the margin; two short lines of numbered verse references below the text (21 and 23) and a final catchword-style line at lower right.

main_text.p: quam sapiet. Sed quoniam aliqui sunt qui iactant se posse multo etiam hausto uino esse compotes mentis, & integri iudicij, rogo eos ut audiant Senecam, epistola iam adducta, qui air: Dicant etiam tales ueneno haust ofe non morituros, nec oppio iumpto dormituros, nec elleboro accepto quicquid in uiscerib{us} haerebit eiectuAfter degeneris?

page.notes: Transcription of this page is partly uncertain: the text is faint and tightly set in places. Several marginal notes and the inner lines of the body are only approximately legible; the left margin notes have been transcribed as printed in the scan, but some letters are doubtful. Items marked [?] should be checked against the original.
